analysis:
Compared all supplied BASE/HEAD integration-test source and examined the added policy-test metadata and bounded patch. CoordinatorIntegrationTests.swift:456-490 adds loopback tests for faster reconnection after close code 1012 and backoff reset after a stable session; :649-726 injects the policy and measures registration after socket closure. Existing encryption, cancellation/reservation release, attestation-message flow, enrollment signatures, telemetry privacy and direct-chunk assertions remain unchanged. No supported security regression arises from these test-only changes; canned signatures and reduced privacy flags remain test fixtures, not production authorization. The added CoordinatorReconnectPolicyTests.swift patch checks stable-session delay ranges, but its remaining source is not supplied.
Integration must verify the corresponding production reconnect policy and socket-close handling: bounded randomized retries and growth for ordinary failures (A-018/TB-002), plus invalidation of old connection authorization and queued/direct outbound work on reconnect (T-053/TB-011). These tests measure re-registration, not fresh serving permission or stale-work rejection. Review the changed MockCoordinator close implementation and scripts/run-provider-tests.sh to confirm the wire injection and CI execution claimed at integration-test lines 10-12. Production behavior and those cross-file changes are outside this batch, so the tests cannot establish those security contracts. No changed cache, privileged-helper, plaintext exposure or billing control is visible here.
